description: A remark plugin for localizing badge images from badge services like shields.io. It downloads badge SVGs at build time, caches them, and rewrites image URLs in markdown and HTML to serve local copies, avoiding external dependencies.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: getBadgeFilename
methods.description: Generates a stable filename for a badge URL based on its hash and URL path.

methods.name: isBadgeUrl
methods.description: Determines if a URL points to a badge that should be localized based on domain and pattern matching.

methods.name: fetchWithRetry
methods.description: Fetches a URL with retry logic and exponential backoff.

methods.name: downloadBadge
methods.description: Downloads a badge SVG from a URL, caches it, and returns the local path.

methods.name: remarkLocalizeBadges
methods.description: Factory function creating a remark plugin that localizes badge images in markdown and HTML.
